reason: Hypothesis A is more physically sound and testable: it proposes a clear mechanism (reduced thermal gradients via substrate preheating) without over-specifying an unvalidated temperature (600 °C) or a fabricated quantitative outcome (15–20% boost), and its falsification experiment is decisive without relying on arbitrary thresholds. Hypothesis B invents precise values and cites evidence that is largely irrelevant to AlCrFeNiSi, undermining its grounding.
